validator: one soft problem: interactive.whatAmILookingAt is 14444 characters, over 12000

faults.finding: Both say the echo 'puts a small ripple on the spectrum, repeating every v ÷ 2x' without saying why. The missing step: the echo is late by its round trip t, so as the frequency rises it slips in and out of step with the main signal, adding then taking away, and it comes back in step each time the frequency rises by 1 ÷ t, which is v ÷ 2x. Screen 3's resonance chain (quarter wave cancels, half wave in step) is complete.
faults.fix: Add the in-and-out-of-step sentence on screen 4 and in explain para 3, so v ÷ 2x follows from the round trip.

faults.finding: 'The software works on the phase, which shows small changes best' overstates the quote, which says the phase 'can be more sensitive to detect soft defects'. 'A matched end soaks up every wave' holds only for an exact match. 'LIRA gives no pass or fail' is the notes' 'no acceptance criteria' and stays. 'One end is enough' on the card is the notes' 'needs access to only one end', and the card says to test from both.
faults.fix: Say the phase 'can show small changes better'. Say 'an end matched exactly to the cable'.

faults.finding: The ripple widening and the spot moving are the effect. The cause, the round trip to the change, is a readout but is not drawn on the cable.
faults.fix: Draw an arrow from the set to the change and back on the small cable drawing, labelled with the round trip, so the shorter trip and the wider ripple are seen together.

faults.finding: The check asks how a nearer spot's ripple compares. It needs the round-trip step, and each wrong choice names the step it misses (farther spot, or confusing the length's resonances with a spot's ripple). Passes.

Six footnotes, each on a rule or figure he would look up: dead and discharged first, the v ÷ 2L spacing, no resonances with a matched end, 0.5% placing, both ends for sensitivity, and the takeaway. The ripple's v ÷ 2x is the lesson's own working from the round trip and is said as a rule worked from TDR's, which the case file records. The 33 kV online limit is his notes' figure and is kept as a plain statement on the card. Passes.
Readouts 'Resonance spacing', 'First dip', 'Round trip', 'Ripple repeats every', 'DNORM' and the switch options read plainly at 360 px. Passes.
